"in standard length ranging from 1,000 to 3,500 mm, each in 3 different main rubber grades"
SX (standard one-piece), SX-P (embedded steel plate), SH (wider frontal face, lower surface load), SH-P (embedded steel plate)
Dimensions SX table: SX 250 (H 250, W 500, w 200, t 18, C 178, PW 400, anchors M24) through SX 1000 (H 1000, W 1800, w 800, t 47, C 610, PW 1550, anchors M48)
Dimensions SH table: SH 250 (H 250, W 625, w 280, t 18, C 203, PW 530, M24) through SH 1000 (H 1000, W 2200, w 1125, t 40, C 663, PW 2000, M48)
